title: Telepathy Tapes: you don't get my powers if you lie

tellings.quote: tapes where one of the kids, I'm forgetting exactly which one, says, uh, "Mom, you don't get my powers if you lie."

plain: In The Telepathy Tapes, a 2024 documentary series made by Ky Dickens about children said to show telepathy, one of the children tells a parent, "Mom, you don't get my powers if you lie." Michels brings it up from the series himself, admitting he forgets which child said it, and offers it as a hint that such abilities might depend on honesty.
